items.title: CVS says GLP-1s save money when priced below $350 per month
items.summary: NEW YORK, Nov 14 (Reuters) - CVS Health said employers and other health plan sponsors could break even on GLP-1 drugs if they are priced below $350 per month as reduced use of medical services, such as hospitalizations and ‌emergency room visits, lower spending enough to offset drug costs. items.title: Nvidia CEO out — 10 stocks to buy before S&P 500 hits 8,000
items.summary: Nvidia (NVDA) is down over 30% from the highs with CEO Jensen Huang stepping down, yet Blanke Schein Wealth Management CIO Robert Schein says the stock is still a buy. He also names Broadcom (AVGO), Apple (AAPL), and Eli Lilly (LLY) among his top picks before the S&P 500 reaches 8,000.
